exceptions.scope: Fine-pointer star-rating labels in src/pages/RecordingFeedback.module.css on the recording page.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner selected the tight star-spacing mockup. Fine-pointer devices use 24px-wide by 44px-high star targets, derived from the semantic medium icon size plus inline-xs spacing. Touch and coarse-pointer devices retain 44px targets. Native radio semantics, cumulative hover previews, keyboard focus indicators, and explicit submission remain unchanged.

exceptions.scope: The mobile-only How it works card sequence in src/pages/HomePage.tsx and src/pages/HomePage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested a repeating image-and-text crossfade with a five-second hold and no dots, navigation arrows, or pause control. This route-local exception permits autoplay without a visible stop control and the user-specified 5000 ms reading interval. The fade duration derives from the semantic interaction duration (3 times). Playback suspends offscreen and in hidden tabs. Reduced motion restores the static list; all step text remains in the accessibility tree without live announcements. Tablet and desktop layouts remain static.

exceptions.scope: The Trusted by cards, caption, and nested decorative stars in src/pages/HomePage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested faded cards, trust text, and stars. No semantic opacity token exists, so this route-local exception permits 0.65 opacity for the cards and caption, including the caption's nested stars. This intentionally reduces resting contrast; cards return to full opacity on hover or keyboard focus, and forced-colors mode restores full opacity throughout. Content, links, spacing, and autoplay behavior remain unchanged.

exceptions.scope: The five decorative Lucide stars after the Trusted by caption in src/pages/HomePage.tsx and their styling in src/pages/HomePage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested five filled black stars at the same size as the caption. This exception permits filled decorative stars at the semantic caption size instead of the standard icon scale. The stars use the semantic primary text color, remain hidden from assistive technology, and do not introduce a numerical review rating.

exceptions.scope: The three screenshot-based previews at public/images/home-step-*-actual.webp and their decorative presentation in the homepage how-it-works section in src/pages/HomePage.tsx.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner requested actual project screenshots. The source captures render the existing submit, share, and analytics routes with repository demo data. Image editing removes browser edges, adds a token-colored surround, replaces the local development origin in the share-link image with the public origin, and restores the submit form's actual 1–2–3 progress indicator from the user's reference. On 2026-09-10 the owner explicitly requested a very gradual left-to-right light-blue to mint to yellow progression across the three previews. This permits simple horizontal gradient backdrops interpolated only from semantic action-tint, success-tint, and warning-tint colors; tint colors here are decorative and convey no status. The first two previews advance through that color progression. At the owner's subsequent request, the third preview reverses direction with pale yellow on the left and mint on the right. All gradients remain gradual and horizontal, without hard midpoints. At the owner's subsequent request, the final analytics screenshot is enclosed by a rounded white surface frame using surface-default white and the existing subtle boundary treatment. The yellow-to-mint gradient remains visible outside this frame, matching the first two screenshot panels. Raster images cannot bind internal pixels to runtime tokens. Section layout, typography, spacing, radius, and responsive presentation continue using existing semantic tokens and canonical layout components.

exceptions.scope: Inline styles that express measured waveform heights, determinate progress widths, SVG coordinates, and calculated placement geometry.
exceptions.rationale: These values represent runtime data or geometry and are not reusable visual constants.

exceptions.scope: Token-derived color literals serialized into index.html theme metadata, the web app manifest, and standalone SVG brand assets.
exceptions.rationale: Browser metadata, JSON manifests, and standalone SVG files cannot consume the application's CSS custom properties. Validation restricts every serialized color to an approved design token and verifies the manifest and theme metadata against their canonical semantic tokens.

exceptions.scope: Unselected platform icons and labels in the Earn platform-preferences dialog, styled in src/Application.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested 65% opacity for unselected platform icons and labels. No semantic opacity token exists, so this route-local exception permits 0.65 opacity on unchecked card content. Card borders use the existing subtle-border token. Selected content and keyboard focus indicators remain at full strength, forced-colors mode restores full opacity, and selection, saving, and persistence behavior remain unchanged.

exceptions.scope: The Earn platform-preferences dialog in src/pages/EarnPage.tsx and src/Application.module.css: its token-colored SVG surface gradient, small sparkle details, device illustration, and Apple and Android platform marks.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested full fidelity to the supplied modal mockup after the gradient and non-Lucide artwork conflicts were reported. The exception is limited to decorative artwork; Dialog, Checkbox, Button, semantic colors, spacing, typography, focus, and responsive behavior remain design-system controlled.

exceptions.scope: The token-colored decorative SVG background gradient on the Earn visibility rank panel in src/pages/EarnPage.tsx and src/pages/EarnPage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested the supplied rank-panel gradient treatment. The exception is limited to the gradient composition; both gradient colors remain semantic design-system tokens.

exceptions.scope: The three supplied decorative PNG illustrations under public/images/how-it-works-*.png and their presentation in src/pages/HomePage.tsx.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly supplied and requested these exact homepage illustrations, including the custom browser, exchange, cyborg, social-symbol, paper-plane, and sparkle artwork. The exception is limited to decorative imagery; layout, sizing, radius, background, and responsive behavior remain design-system token controlled, and the images are hidden from assistive technology. Under decision 0005, the cyborg concept is v1 evidence and an implementation launch blocker, not a current recruitment claim.

exceptions.scope: The decorative Apple and Android platform marks in the testable-products section of src/pages/HomePage.tsx and their tokenized presentation in src/pages/HomePage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested reuse of the recognizable iOS and Android marks already used by the Earn platform filters. The exception is limited to those two decorative brand marks; the Web and Prototypes icons use Lucide, and layout, sizing, color, spacing, typography, and responsive behavior remain design-system controlled.

exceptions.scope: The illustration-scale decorative icons in the testable-products section of src/pages/HomePage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested oversized feature icons matching the supplied homepage reference. The exception is limited to this section and derives every icon dimension and stroke from canonical semantic size and border tokens; icon color, spacing, typography, and responsive layout remain design-system controlled.

exceptions.scope: The token-sized, continuously looping left-to-right card track in the Trusted by section of src/pages/HomePage.tsx and src/pages/HomePage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly requested continuous left-to-right movement for the public Earn-card showcase. The exception is limited to the long linear loop; the section provides pause and resume controls, pauses on hover and focus, removes autoplay for reduced motion, and keeps all layout and card presentation design-system controlled.

exceptions.scope: The supplied looping monkey media and muted grayscale treatment in the managed-recruitment comparison section of src/pages/HomePage.tsx and src/pages/HomePage.module.css.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner explicitly selected these two photographic loops, requested that the competitor image receive a lower-attention grayscale treatment, and requested an uncluttered comparison without a visible animation control. The exception is limited to the supplied media and its filter/opacity values; the section serves static posters for reduced motion, hides decorative imagery from assistive technology, and keeps layout, color, typography, spacing, borders, and controls design-system token controlled.

exceptions.scope: Existing HTML embedded in Supabase Edge Functions under supabase/functions.
exceptions.rationale: The approved migration explicitly excludes Supabase Function changes. Repository email previews use the new system; production function templates require a separately authorized backend migration and deployment.

exceptions.scope: The route-local credit and sharing demos in src/pages/HomePage.tsx, their CSS in src/pages/HomePage.module.css, and video/poster assets under public/videos/home-earn-credit* and public/videos/home-share-test*.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner approved the short credit and sharing demos and explicitly requested replacing their corresponding homepage images with the optimized videos. On 2026-09-10 the owner explicitly requested removal of the visible playback control. This permits the recorded cursor timing and silent repeating playback without overlay controls as a limited exception to the motion foundation. Both videos retain the existing 3:2 media frames, semantic action-tint background, and token-controlled radius. Each downloads only on visible playback and pauses outside the viewport or a visible tab. Reduced motion and data-saving preferences disable automatic loading/playback and leave static posters; the credit demo uses its earned-credit confirmation as its static fallback. Pre-rendered internal pixels use repository token colors and Geist, but cannot bind to runtime CSS variables.

exceptions.scope: The two user-supplied UI illustrations, prepared as public/images/home-feedback-earn-credit.webp and public/images/home-feedback-share-test.webp, plus the approved light variant public/images/home-feedback-share-test-light.webp, in the homepage free-feedback section.
exceptions.rationale: The design owner requested these exact illustrated concepts, including the credit star and overlapping UI cards. On 2026-09-10 the owner selected the compact alternating mockup, replacing the sharing artwork's dark backdrop with the semantic action tint and adding blue card outlines while retaining all illustration content. This exception covers only the decorative raster artwork, whose internal pixels cannot bind to runtime tokens. Surrounding layout, colors, typography, spacing, image radius, and responsive behavior consume design-system tokens; adjacent existing copy conveys the meaning and images are hidden from assistive technology.
